pois.name: Dunia Fantasi (Dufan)
pois.description: Indonesia's largest and oldest theme park, open since 1985. 25 thrilling rides including the Halilintar roller coaster, Kora-Kora Viking ship, and Istana Boneka indoor puppet ride.

pois.name: Jakarta Aquarium Sea World
pois.description: Southeast Asia's first and largest oceanarium, featuring a 35-metre underwater acrylic tunnel with sharks, rays, and 14,000 marine animals across 40 exhibits.

pois.name: Pantai Ancol
pois.description: Jakarta's main urban beach resort stretching 4km along the Java Sea. Popular for weekend escapes with palm-lined promenades, jet-ski rentals, and sunset views toward the Thousand Islands.

pois.name: Atlantis Water Adventure
pois.description: Large water park within the Ancol resort complex — slides, wave pools, and lazy rivers, with 14 water attractions across 5 hectares.

pois.name: Pasar Seni Ancol
pois.description: Ancol's arts market — 350 workshops and galleries where visitors can watch batik painting, wayang carving, and silver jewellery making before purchasing directly from artisans.
